title: A Weighted Kolmogorov Metric under Sub-Cubic Moments: Admissible Parameters and an Obstruction
summary: We study a weighted version of the Kolmogorov distance, in which the usual uniform distance between distribution functions is damped by a weight that decays away from the centre of the distribution. The motivation is the classical gap in the central limit theorem: when only a moment of order slightly above two is available, the uniform Berry-Esseen bound gives a rate strictly slower than the optimal square-root rate, and one may hope that de-emphasising the tails recovers the optimal rate.
